name: I Won't Back Down
source:
In this story you will assume Vicky, a Futanari girl who left home as a teenager to escape her problems, but when the people she loves start to go through serious problems she decides to come back to help them.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
在这个故事中，你将扮演Vicky，一个Futanari女孩，十几岁时为了逃避问题而离家出走，但当她所爱的人开始遇到严重问题时，她决定回来帮助他们。

[来自F95Zone]
